notes: Every factor cites its source, vintage and region. When implementing the ef_loader service, look up by 'id'. Ranges (min/max) are for uncertainty disclosure; use 'value' as the point estimate in the deterministic formula.

electricity_grid_in_all_india.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, v20.0, Dec 2024
electricity_grid_in_all_india.notes: Weighted-average grid EF including renewable and captive generation, excluding inter-grid imports. Used as location-based Scope 2 factor per GHG Protocol.

coal_indian_bituminous.source: IPCC AR6 default (95700 kgCO2/TJ) applied to Indian coal NCV per PPAC 2023-24
coal_indian_bituminous.notes: Combustion CO2 only; add CH4 and N2O factors separately if higher accuracy required.

coal_indian_lignite.source: IPCC AR6 default × Indian lignite NCV

natural_gas_indian_grid.source: IPCC AR6 default × Indian NG composition (GAIL public data)

biomass_bagasse.source: IPCC AR6 Guidelines — biomass is CO2-neutral for direct CO2 accounting; report separately
biomass_bagasse.notes: Biomass CO2 combustion is considered neutral under GHG Protocol if sustainably sourced. CH4 and N2O emissions from combustion still apply.

biomass_rice_husk.source: IPCC AR6 Guidelines; TERI biomass characterization studies

road_freight_medium_truck.source: DEFRA GHG Reporting 2024 — HGV rigid 7.5-17t, average laden

road_freight_heavy_truck.source: DEFRA GHG Reporting 2024 — HGV articulated >33t, average laden

rail_freight_in.source: DEFRA 2024; Indian Railways electrification factor applied

sea_freight_container.source: DEFRA GHG Reporting 2024 — container shipping, average

refrigerant_r22_gwp100.source: IPCC AR6 Working Group I, Table 7.SM.7

refrigerant_r134a_gwp100.source: IPCC AR6 Working Group I, Table 7.SM.7

gwp_ch4_100yr.source: IPCC AR6 Working Group I, Table 7.SM.7 — GWP100 for fossil methane (non-biogenic)

gwp_n2o_100yr.source: IPCC AR6 Working Group I, Table 7.SM.7

water_treatment_electric_pump.notes: Typical ETP/STP pump + aeration blower energy per kL treated. Multiply by grid EF for tCO2e.
water_treatment_electric_pump.source: CPCB Textile Effluent Treatment Manual; BEE ETP benchmarking

process_cement_clinker.source: IPCC AR6; India Cement Sustainability Initiative
process_cement_clinker.notes: Chemical process emissions from calcination, excluding fuel combustion.

purchased_steel_scrap.source: worldsteel LCI 2023 — scrap-based EAF route (India adapted)
purchased_steel_scrap.notes: Scope 3 Category 1 (purchased goods) for downstream steel users.

purchased_aluminium_india_avg.source: International Aluminium Institute 2023; CEA grid intensity applied

purchased_cotton_yarn.source: Higg MSI 2023 (Sustainable Apparel Coalition); regional adaptation for Indian cotton
